pump.story: A deep cold pool over the Atlantic: about 5 km up, -30.1 C and 15.9 C colder than normal on 29 Sep 12 UTC near 49N 31.5W; -25.7 C and 11.7 C colder than normal on 30 Sep 12 UTC near 45.5N 14.5W. It swung toward Iberia, weakened and broke up from 1 Oct, leaving a shallow trough over Spain. On 3 Oct the 850 hPa wind off Barcelona blew from the south-east (123 deg) at 10.4 m/s, onshore from the record-warm sea.
not_claimed: unusually cold air directly over Barcelona on 3 Oct (+1.4 C at 500 hPa)
a closed low off Spain on 3 Oct (heights rise only 15-20 m within 300-500 km)
